A01.summary: Camelot uses state-conditioned ambient speech and named knights; Grail/radius/mode facts choose messages. A small cursor cycles available remarks. Movement transfers name identity. Princess rescue has separate scoped state, not a general conversation engine. Whole speech corpus and every princess branch remain unread.
yairpg: K6/K20/K31, P21: original acknowledgements read real local achievement.
K6/K11, P19: add a useful conversation consumer only if a chosen slice needs it.

A02.summary: Narrative arrives through help, action messages, objective paths, rescue and local acknowledgement. Yendor key-to-orb records carry quest progress and closure. No general novel-scale canon clock or career journal was established by this pass; full rescue narrative remains unread.
yairpg: K11/K12/K16, P12: objective state and caused aftermath need distinct owners.
K5/K15: neighboring lands are regions, not automatically separate worlds.

A03.summary: C++ module set with X-macro metadata and code-driven rule consumers. A tiling graph underlies local generation. Turn processing orders environment and actors; shmup has an elapsed-time executor. Movement keeps reversible mutations and delayed committed effects. Coverage is architecture for this lane, not every engine module.
yairpg: K2/K13/K34, P14/P16: validate the actual consumers of a local law.
Start/branch IR1-IR4: use typed native effects rather than porting globals.

A04.summary: Versioned append score records and positional numeric boxes preserve selected run fields; Safety regeneration and separate settings/map-stream paths have different lifetimes. Faraway-memory cleanup can discard terrain history. No complete save graph, atomicity, migration matrix, corruption recovery or offline-reward guarantee was established.
yairpg: K18/K33, P16/P24: definitions, run ledgers and actual retained world state differ.
P23: retain YAIRPG complete native envelope; do not replace it with score-box reconstruction.

A05.summary: Movement/path and monster classes have local legalities, segmented bodies, pace and hostility exceptions. Witch/golem pursuit is limited by region; cave and electricity consumers also read creatures. NATIVE classifies local reward relevance separately from AI. No comprehensive planner, autonomous career schedule or general social faction life was shown.
yairpg: K10/K13/K15, P14: imported creatures retain actual movement/body constraints.
K6/K7, P25: do not infer a general NPC society from tactical actors.

A06.summary: Context help combines metadata, requirements and special rules; HUD shows run resources; movement issues explain named causes; mode menus separate local records. Source structure inspected, no display or keyboard usability exercised. Public help is more omniscient than YAIRPG character knowledge.
yairpg: K11/K14/K30, P04: project actual command blockers into a known local rule panel at 1366x768.
Keep useful desktop panels independent; mobile deferred.

A07.summary: Content metadata is centralized with stable enum-order guidance, but new mechanics need C++ consumers. Eclectic City calls WFC generation and repairs mixed borders. Editors, pattern tools and devmods are found, not fully audited. No universal data-only mod API or load-order contract is established.
yairpg: K1/K33/K34, P16/P22: compile/lint references and preserve revisions.
A catalog row is not implemented local law.

A08.summary: Treasure and kills feed distinct spawn formulas; PT substitutes mode-dependent rates, custom lists scale them and chaos multiplies some rates. big_unlock changes unlock thresholds. Trait bits jointly affect hazards and reward rates. No full RNG audit, simulated balance or big-number progression was performed.
yairpg: K3/K10/K13/K34, P14/P17: show the selected local cost rather than normalizing all power systems.
Keep source balance numbers as examples, not accepted YAIRPG rates.

A09.summary: Normal play advances turn phases; power use/decay and Speed alter consumers. Shmup advances clamped elapsed simulation with focus/pause handling, projectile motion and periodic environment updates. This bounded scheduling read shows distinct play clocks, not browser-closed catch-up or a lived calendar.
yairpg: K18/K26/K28/K32, P13: explicit local clock and absence policy.
Do not turn real-time rendering delta into idle job rewards.

A10.summary: Treasure/kills unlock regions and powers; local orb availability commonly grows into hub and foreign availability. Per-land help explains requirements. Tactics depends largely on prior accomplishment; Yendor Challenge follows a normal victory. Guided tour exists but was not followed.
yairpg: K4/K11/K13, P04/P09: earned use can teach a local grammar.
Retain default/dial access for YAIRPG solo options; no universal mode qualification.

A11.summary: State-aware warnings, dynamic help, matching cues, contextual speech, named actors and distinct pickup sounds make rules legible. Sound/graphics implementation symbols were inspected; perceived quality, accessibility and timing were not tested. 28 original touches are proposed in SMALL_TOUCHES.
yairpg: K14/K19/K20/K30, P04/P15/P21: give each cue a real state reader.
Visual and human-feel acceptance stay open until a selected UI change is rebuilt and exercised.

A12.summary: Mode-qualified achievements, consecutive-run scoring, stored orb activation economy, sentient-die orientation puzzles and specialized land structures reuse content under different rules. Full optional subsystem and achievement catalogs were not behaviorally audited. OSM forbidden-history assignment has an apparent prior-tile-item mismatch, with runtime consequences untested.
yairpg: K16/K17/K34, P14/P15: reusable content supports several chosen rule sets.
